note: Prehistoric variant of stickman-v1 for Fossil Receipts (owner, 2026-10-24): messy hair and beards, heavy brow, stronger expressions, dirty and worn hides. Same head, limbs and proportions as v1. Hair colour and style are a drawing convention, not a claim. Change a block only by creating stickman-v3.json, never by editing this file in place.
style: STYLE (stickman-v2, prehistoric): Flat 2D cartoon illustration. Every person is a clothed stick figure: large round plain white head with a bold, slightly rough black outline, a quarter of the figure's height. Every person has thick, messy, unkempt hair: a flat dark mass of jagged clumped strands and stray tufts; a beard only when the character card asks for it. Every face has a heavy black brow stroke set low over two small solid black dot eyes and an expressive mouth; strong expressions from brow angle, short wrinkle lines and mouths that may show a few blocky uneven teeth. Nobody looks clean: small grey-brown dirt smudges on the head and hands; scars only where the card says so. Almost no neck. Arms are single thick black lines with angular elbows, ending in small white oval mitten hands outlined in black. The body is rough, untailored animal hide about as wide as the head: ragged torn edges, uneven fur tufts, stains and grime; nothing new, sewn, neat or symmetrical. Bare legs are single thick black lines; feet are small rounded lumps in crude muddy hide wraps. Stocky, slightly hunched, about 3.7 heads tall. Flat muted earthy fills (dirty browns, ochres, greys), bold black outlines, short tick marks for fur, dirt and wear; no gradients, no glossy highlights. Never add a nose, ears, fingers, pupils, eye whites, skin colour, realistic anatomy, a 3D look or a photographic look.
animals: ANIMALS: animals use the same bold black outlines, flat muted fills and small solid black dot eyes as the people, with simple rounded shapes and realistic body proportions and size; fur appears only as a few short tick marks; animals never get stick limbs or white circle heads.
background_people: BACKGROUND PEOPLE: any unnamed people are the same stick figures with messy hair and dirty, ragged plain hides, smaller and simpler, with no accessories that belong to a named character.
setting_style: SETTING STYLE: the environment is drawn in the same flat cartoon style but quieter: slightly thinner outlines, lower contrast, muted desaturated colours, simple shapes and a few texture marks, with clear depth from foreground to background. Keep a mid-tone surface behind every white head so the heads stay readable.
sheet_background: on a flat pure white background with no scenery, no ground line, no borders, no frames and no shadows
format_scene: FORMAT: one single widescreen 16:9 landscape image. Keep every character and key object well inside the frame, away from the edges and away from the bottom-right corner.
exclusion_scene: The image contains no text at all: no letters, numbers, labels, captions, logos or speech bubbles; every paper, screen and sign is blank.
reference_guard: Do not copy the reference sheet's white background, layout, labels or poses; draw a new scene.
history_line: Make every garment, tool, object and building historically accurate for {era}; nothing anachronistic.

expressions.neutral: heavy flat brow, mouth turned slightly down
expressions.smiling: relaxed brow, eye-corner crinkles, wide closed smile
expressions.happy: eyes as upward arcs, open grin with blocky teeth
expressions.sad: brow pinched up at the inner ends, downturned mouth, a tear streak through the dirt
expressions.scared: brow shot up high, tension lines by the eyes, mouth open in a gasp
expressions.surprised: brow raised in high arcs, round open O mouth
expressions.confused: one brow low, one high, crooked mouth
expressions.determined: brow pressed low, firm straight mouth
expressions.tired: drooping half-closed eyes, slack open mouth
expressions.pain: eyes squeezed shut, knotted brow, grimace with clenched teeth
expressions.caring: soft raised brow, gentle half-closed eyes, small warm smile

back_view: in the back view the head shows only the hair mass from behind
